RESULT [labelnoise]: Detection pseudo-label F1 improved by 28% for the worst-performing baseline categories and by 44% with task-specific fine-tuning. Pruning also revived classes that had zero recall.
US [labelnoise]: This is a candidate replacement for the fixed OWLv2 score threshold. The weakest species, which are the ones that matter for the robot, gain the most. Code and weights are released, so a trial on harvested OWLv2 proposals is cheap.

US [selftrain]: This is a candidate design for the labeller agent's accept/reject step, taking it beyond a fixed score cutoff.
